title: NEXUS Tool Metadata
description: Metadata document for a NEXUS tool, e.g. extensions/tools/built_in/<tool>/<tool>.jsnol. Informational schema only; not enforced at runtime.

name.description: Tool identifier used to invoke it.

description.description: What the tool does; used by the model to decide when to call it.

entry.description: Relative path to the tool's Python entrypoint (e.g. scripts/terminal.py).

class.description: Tool class name implementing the tool (e.g. TerminalTool).

params.description: Tool parameters keyed by parameter name.

required.description: Whether the parameter is required for the call.

default.description: Default value used when the parameter is omitted.

category.description: Tool category used for grouping (e.g. system, knowledge).

riskLevel.description: Optional risk classification used for permission/sandbox decisions.

capabilities.description: Optional capability tags describing what the tool can do.
